name: capture.file
description: A new file for a capture: the copy of the shared reel or post, in the type Meta served it. Answers a signed write URL and the file's stable address. Internal: packages/connect copies the media, as the principal META_WEBHOOK_AS names.
sql: update brandbase.captures c set file_key = :file where c.id = :id returning jsonb_build_object('upload', jsonb_build_object('key', c.file_key, 'type', :mime::text)) as result
